messages:
alex: Heads up — main is red after the constraints update earlier. Tests failing in auth service on import errors. https://ci.example.com/4392 :/
ci-bot: Build 4392 failed: tests/unit/auth/test_session.py::TestSession::test_cookie_load (flake: 1 failure). Logs: https://ci.example.com/4392/logs
morgan: quick skim of the stack trace looks like ImportError: cannot import name 'cached_property' from 'werkzeug' — did werkzeug get bumped to v3?
sam: which change touched the constraints.txt? I can try a local install and repro.
ingrid: that was my constraints bump PR (deps-bump-2026). I ran pip-compile and it picked up some newer majors, didn't expect werkzeug to jump. sorry 😬
alyssa: @ingrid can you paste the top of the failing traceback? Also tag a quick revert if it's obvious.
alex: snippet from CI log:
```
File "/app/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/flask/helpers.py", line 95, in <module>
from werkzeug.wrappers import cached_property
ImportError: cannot import name 'cached_property' from 'werkzeug' (unknown location)
```
alex: I tried a local venv with the previous pinned werkzeug and tests pass. Pinning to werkzeug==2.3.7 fixes the import.
ingrid: ok, i'll open a revert PR pinning werkzeug and regen the constraints to lock the minor. Should we do 2.3.7 explicitly?
morgan: 2.3.7 sounds fine as a short-term fix. We should also add an allowlist in our pip-compile config to avoid auto-major bumps for critical infra packages.
sam: Agreed. Also can someone bisect quickly to confirm no other transitive changed package is to blame? If it's just werkzeug we can revert and unblock.
ingrid: doing revert PR now, will request a rerun. cc @alex for quick review.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by ingrid — queued as Build 4393.
ci-bot: Build 4393 passed (tests/unit/auth). :tada:
alex: nice, thanks @ingrid. Follow-up: create an issue to tighten pip-compile policy + add a test that imports flask helpers early in the suite so this fails fast in CI if it happens again.
alyssa: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/2273 referencing this thread
thread_summary: constraints update caused werkzeug major bump -> ImportError in auth tests. Reverted pin to werkzeug==2.3.7, reran CI, fixed. Follow-up: pinning policy and test added requested.
